result.statement: For the exact dense three-bank family A_m=T_m[I-(2+1/m)nn^T]T_m^T, n=(1,2,3)/sqrt(14), and bankwise symmetric cap-one three-interval laws with eps_j=L_j/m, L_j->infinity, L_j=o(m), R_j->infinity and eps_j R_j^2->tau_j<infinity, the full output densities converge uniformly to the centered Gaussian quadratic-form density with bank variances v_j=1/12+tau_j. Its global maximum is at zero and at most 3sqrt(2), with equality only when all tau_j=0. If all tau_j=tau then ||p_Qm||infinity -> 3sqrt(2)/(1+12tau).
result.source_laws: independent original physical coordinate densities of height one on one central and two symmetric satellite intervals, total support length one
result.continuity_scope: continuous densities for this explicit family via the uniform integrable characteristic-function envelope; no unrestricted continuity claim

partner_applied.receiver_use: Used its exact variance and third-absolute-moment formulas to prove the finite-tax triangular Lyapunov CLT at eps R^2 -> tau.

required_source_applied.receiver_inequality: For the actual physical eigenframe, row leverage=1/m, Gram=I_3 and residual=0, hence |Psi_m(t)|<=min(1,(4pi)^(3/2)(1+1/m)^(-1/2)|t|^(-3/2)); the common majorant has mass 24pi and upgrades weak convergence to global uniform output-density convergence.

unresolved_implication: The finite-tax symmetric fragmented three-bank basin cannot exceed 3sqrt(2). Remaining source-valid sharp-witness mechanisms require non-Gaussian multiscale arrays that evade triangular CLT behavior, macroscopic non-collinear shared rows not collapsing to three independent banks, or additional active spectrum surviving aggregation.
next_step: Stress a genuinely non-Gaussian multiscale rough-law construction at dimension-growing no-pivot/hub geometry while preserving cap-one product provenance and exact spectral threshold; distinguish a finite >3sqrt(2) sharp-constant witness from a true unbounded-density QFORM counterexample.
